name: My Son's Girlfriend - Paths of Corruption
source: Stan brings his girlfriend home for the big game. Sarah was his father's student a few years ago. Beers, a football final on TV… and a game of dares that starts as a joke.​
translation: 斯坦带女朋友回家一起看重磅球赛。几年前，莎拉曾是他父亲教过的学生。冰镇啤酒、电视里的橄榄球决赛……还有一场起初只是闹着玩的真心话大冒险。
